betterquesting:10.desc:8: There are multiple ways of processing at this stage, most efficient being the §3Arc Furnace§r.

The §3Boiler§r, when receiving heat from below, heats up fluids. Two important uses of the boiler are for §bSteam§r and §bOil§r processing which will come later on. The Boiler can explode if its output is full.

Steam, when used by machines, such as reactors sending steam through §3Turbines§r or §3Chemical Factories§r produce §bLow-Pressure Steam§r. The low-pressure steam can be recycled back to retrieve 100% of the water by using a §3Steam Condenser§r. Closed water loops are recommended for reactors.

§6Tantalum§r is a material needed for the creation of some items, most importantly §6Capacitor Boards§r. Tantalum Polycrystal production requires §6Coltan§r which can be located by the use of a §6Coltass§r. Tantalum can be obtained from using §bHigh-Performance Solvent§r on §eHeavy Metal Bedrock Ore§r.

§2Coltan Processing at its early stage can provide Niobium needed for Catalytic Cracking Towers.

The §3Deuterium Extractor Tower§r is a much larger version of the Deuterium Extractor, making it an easy and viable way of making cheap fuel for the §b§r§3Fusion Reactor§r.

§2A Ferrouranium Anvil is required.§r

§3Tanks§r and §3Barrels§r are useful storage devices that can hold various fluids in various amounts. Each tank and barrel supports holding different types of corrosive, hot, or exotic fluids, and knowing which ones can hold your desired fluids can be vital to your fluid processing and storage facilities.

Tanks can hold up to 256,000mb of fluids, while a Steel Barrel can hold 16,000.

§4§2Tanks cant hold highly Antimatter and Corrosive fluids and as such a Big-Ass Tank 9000 or a Magnetic Tank is needed respectively.
The §6Jetpack§r can be used to travel upwards. It can be upgraded to unlock additional abilities, and can be equiped as an armor modification.
Redstone-Over-Radio, as its name suggests, is used to wirelessly transmit redstone signals. There are various types of components, all of which being very useful for precise automation.

§6Hard Plastic/PVC Bars§r are very durable plastics needed for many late game recipes. 

§2Both can be used in the same recipes.

The §3Electric Arc Furnace§r is a large automated furnace multiblock machine that can fill the role of §3Crucible§r and automated smelter, and is required for progression as it is the only machine that can produce §6Silicon§r from various sources, such as §6Sand§r, §6Flint§r, §6fiberglass§r, and §6Asbestos§r.

To operate this machine, it will require both electrical power and crafted §7§6Electrodes§r. In terms of electricity, the machine has a maximum storage capacity of §e2.5MHE§r, and consumes §e20kHE/s§r in operation, making it reasonably power hungry. In terms of the electrodes required for operation, there are four types available, and the machine must have three installed before it can operate.

This machine can operate in two different modes: Solid mode, which is the easiest to setup and use, great for initial crafting, and Liquid mode, which produces castable molten ores much like the crucible, with a small bonus to output, increasing efficiency of extraction from various ores.
An upgraded version of the §3Anvil§r, [T7], which unlocks additional recipes.
The §6Settings Tool§r is used to copy settings of machines. It is especially useful when making large refineries.
The §3Soldering Station§r is the machine in which §6§rcircuit components§r can be combined§6§r into §6Circuits§r and where §6Machine Upgrades§r can be created.

The §3Leviathan Steam Turbine§r is a massive turbine capable of processing gargantuan amounts of §bSteam§r at once, only hindered by the fluid system's transfer rate. It is significantly more powerful than even the §3Industrial Steam Turbine§r in terms of raw steam processing power. This turbine runs on §e85%§r Efficiency, so it is recommended that only 1-2 are used for very large reactors.

§bAntimatter§r is a dangerous substance which can be obtained from a §3Cyclotron§r or a §3Particle Accelerator§r. If dropped on the floor a violent explosion will occur. Antimatter cant be stored in normal tanks, and as such, a §3Magnetic Antimatter Container§r is required.

The §3Hydraulic Fracking Tower§r is used to extract infinite oil from a §eBedrock Oil Deposit§r. To operate, the machine needs §bFracking Solution§r. During its operation, the surrounding environment will sustain considerable damage. §6Oily Dirt§r and §6Oily Sand§r can be used to create §6Arsenic§r, a substitute of §6Bismuth§r.

Operating the hydraulic fracking tower will consume §e100kHE/s§r.

§2This quest serves as a guide on how to precisely input items in an arc furnace as not to waste electrode durability.§r

Assuming no upgrades are inserted in the §3Arc Furnace§r, there are exactly 20 slots available for items. To start, route all input items into a §3Conveyor Boxer§r which will send items into a §3Conveyor Unboxer§r. Adding speed ejection and stack ejection upgrades to the unboxer is highly recommended as so the items are inputed fast enough.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_ARC1.png[/img]

Place a §3Redstone-Over-Radio Item Counter§r on one side of the boxer, set the item filter and give it an ID.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_ARC2.png[/img]

Then place a Redstone-Over-Radio Logic Receiver, give it the correct ID, and set it to emit redstone when item count is 20.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_ARC3.png[/img]

Make sure that the boxer has its mode set to redstone.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_ARC4.png[/img]
§6Starmetal§r is a unique alloy made from combining §6Saturnite§r with §6Meteorite Powder§r in a §3Blast Furnace§r.

Sand in an §3Ore Acidizer§r can be turned into §6Fiberglass§r, which provides more than §e4x§r the amount of §6Silicon§r in an §3Arc Furnace§r. Additionally, it provides a great recipe for insulators.

For greater distances, and improved aesthetics, a new distribution node is available, the §3Large Electricity Pylon§r.

§3Substations§r are needed to step up/down the voltage that the line carries.

These Pylons can prove useful as favorable §eBedrock Ore§r or §eOil deposits§r may be located far away from the main base.

The §3Steel Furnace§r, unlike the other furnaces, runs off of §eTU§r. It can also process up to 3 items at a time, but each slot consumes more TU, which makes it slow without a strong heat source. It also has a bonus output for ores and wood, where every smelted item gives §e25%§r to the bonus output meter, which means every 4 items give an extra 5th item for free (§e+15 items from a single stack§r).
The §6Spark Singularity§r is a singularity made from combining all the types of singularities with §6Dineutronium§r.

§6Saturnite§r is a very durable, heat-resistant and corrosion-resistant alloy that is commonly used for making stronger gun parts. It is also used to make §6Starmetal§r and is an important component of the §3Watz§r reactor.

The §3Mining Laser§r is a laser drill which can be used to quickly dig large areas. It has a §e100MHE§r internal power buffer and a 64,000mB internal §bCrude Oil§r buffer. Its default radius is 3, which can be increased by the use of an effectiveness upgrade. It can also be equiped with various upgrades to unlock new functions such as shredding or voiding.

The §c§r§4§r§6Digamma Particle§r is created by colliding a §6Sparkticle Capsule§r with a §6Higgs Boson Capsule§r in a §3Particle Accelerator§r. Making it in the particle accelerator will require §6Chlorophyte Coils§r and a fourth loop, at a momentum of 70,000.

The digamma particle emits a different kind of radiation, §4DRX§r, which currently can only be countered by the use of digamma medication, most notably §6Enteramine Pills§r, which provide full immunity against DRX for 10 minutes. After the §3DFC§r, Fau armor can be crafted which provides full resistance against DRX.

The §6Neutrino Lens§r is an armor modification which can detect and highlight special blocks, such as §eBedrock Ore deposits§r, the §6Pink Log§r and §6Alexandrite§r. 

For the lens to work, it must first be linked to a §6Depth-Resource Scanning Module Satellite§r and then inserted into an armor piece using the §3Armor Modification Table§r.

§2The HUD key has to be activated for it to work.
Roast your bedrock ore again for additional §bVitriol§r.

§dStorage Drawer Keys§r can be used to modify Drawers in many ways.

The §dDrawer Key locks drawers§r, so no new item types can be inserted into the drawer when its empty.

The §dConcealment Key§r hides the item icon of drawers.

The §dQuantify Key§r shows the item quantities of drawers.

The §dPersonal Key§r protects drawers from other players (outside of claims).

§6Wood§r obtained from a tree farm can be smelted or processed in a §3Combination Oven§r to produce §6Charcoal§r, which has many uses, such as fuel for §3Furnaces§r or even the §3Blast Furnace§r, §6Flux§r or §6Carbon§r in a Crucible for §6Steel§r production, or even §6Gunpowder§r for ammunition.

§6Bakelite§r is an alternative to Polymer and can be used for the same recipes. Since it doesnt require any §6Coal Powder§r or §6Fluorite§r to be made, it is easier and more convenient to automate than §6Polymer§r.

The §3Battery Socket§r is used to hold §6Batteries§r or §6Capacitors§r.

Batteries have more energy storage, but a slower discharge time, meaning that only a small amount of stored power can be outputted to the grid.

Capacitors on the other hand, have less energy storage, but a faster discharge time.

The §3Fusion Reactor Coupler§r turns outgoing plasma energy from a torus into usable §eKyE§r which can then be used to power another torus. Some fuel combinations require this, as the minimum §eKyE§r energy needed to ignite the plasma exceeds what four §3Klystrons§r could deliver.

The §3Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber§r uses neutron flux from a torus to in order to process materials. It can perform any recipe from an §3RBMK irradiation channel§r, with some additional recipes aswell. The neutron flux is not affected by port sharing rules, and the output level is the same on any side.

The §3Fusion Reactor Collection Chamber§r increases the byproduct production rate by §e50%§r.

§3Pneumatic Pipes§r are an instant form of item transportation which can cover large distances. The pipes must have §bCompressed Pressurised Air§r, which can be created from taking compressed air from an §3Air Intake§r and compressing it in a §3Compressor.

§6Rubber§r is an essential material used in many crafting recipes. It is created in a §3Chemical Plant§r with §bUnsaturated Hydrocarbons§r obtained from a §3Catalytic Cracking Tower§r.

§6Latex§r is a rubber alternative which can be used in some recipes instead of normal rubber. It can be created early on using a §3Burner Press§r by processing dandelions or jungle wood.
The §3Strand Caster§r is a large basin that can cast items in batches of 9. It also requires §bWater§r in order to cast, where it makes §bLow-Pressure Steam§r that can be turned back into water.

§2For recipes that demand high momentum, additional loops are needed. This quest serves as a guide on how to change the direction of particles.§r

Below is a miniature particle accelerator built for showcasing purposes. It is not connected to power, coolant or have any coils. It does not have rf cavities and uses two particle detectors as outputs. A compass is also provided in the image.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_PA1.png[/img]

After constructing your PA, assuming the beamlines face the right directions, head over to the magnet that bridges the first and second loops.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_PA2.png[/img]

Open its GUI and configure the dipole magnet. 

The first line is for particles that havent reached the desired momentum. 

The second line is for particles that have reached the desired momentum. 

The third line is for particles that have reached the desired momentum AND are powered by redstone.

The §cRed Line§r shows the direction the particle will travel towards and the §9Blue Line§r shows where the player is facing.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_PA3.png[/img]

Make sure that for this specific dipole magnet the third line has the particle orientation facing towards the second loop, NORTH in this case.

After this, the redstone logic must be set in order to be able to turn the particle orientation when powered. Simply provide power underneath the dipole magnet as such. A redstone signal should only exist when a particle needs momentum greater than what the first tier of coil allows.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_PA4.png[/img]

Head over, WEST in this case, to the dipole magnet which is after the transitionary dipole and right before the detector, and which connects to the rest of the loop.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_PA5.png[/img]

Open its GUI and configure it. Make sure the second line is facing towards the particle detector and the first line towards the other dipole magnets.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_PA6.png[/img]

The §3HE to RF Converter§r will convert energy produced by NTM machines into usuable power for both the §dMatter Energy Network§r. It has a very large internal energy buffer, so it is recommended that a Diode is used to limit throughput.
§6Murky Wings§r are an armor modification which grants creative flight at super fast speeds.
The §6Chicken Nugget§r is the best food item in the mod, completely filling up both hunger and saturation. It is made by colliding 2 raw chickens in a Particle Accelerator.
The §6Yharonite Billet§r is created in a tungsten crate that has §6Polonium Billets§r in it while being shot from a §3DFC Emitter§r. This is the final material obtained in the mod.
§6Chlorophyte§r is a product of fusion and is used in the §3DFC§r and §6Digamma Particle§r.
§6Tachyon§r particles are created by colliding §6Higgs Boson§r and §6Muon particles§r.

The §3Steam Engine§r is an early game method of turning §bSteam§r into energy. It requires an external source to provide steam and a way to dump or reprocess the §bLow-Pressure Steam§r it produces. 

The Steam Engine has an energy efficiency of §e85%§r, making it better than the §3Stirling Engine§r. However, it still has a throughput limit as it can only hold up to 2000 mB of steam. Its maximum processing rate is 2000 mB/t, producing a considerable §e3400 HE/t§r or §e68 kHE/s§r. It is therefore the best generator available before §3Steam Turbines§r.

A boiler being heated up by a heating oven using coal will produce §e17kHE/s§r.
§6Welded Osmiridium Plates§r cost 300 Billion §eHE§r to produce, so good energy generation and storage infrastructure is needed.

The §6Pollution Detector§r will monitor and show the levels of pollution present in the environment. High levels of pollution will decrease the visibility, give debuffs to the player and buff mobs, including skeletons spawning with firearms.

The §3PUREX§r is a machine that can reprocess depleted nuclear fuel into various materials. Most recipes require both §bNitric Acid§r and §bKerosene§r to function.

§6Schrabidium§r can also be extracted from certain recipes, which require §bSchrabidic Acid§r. The schrabidium extracted yields double the schrabidium used to make the acid.
The §3High-Power Steam Condenser§r is the a steam condenser which runs on electricity. It processes up to 60 mB/t of §bLow-Pressure Steam§r.
§6Sparkticle§r is made from colliding §6Strange Quark§r particles and §6Pulverized Enchantment§r.

The §3Fusion Reactor§r is a large, expensive, and advanced reactor type that runs by fusing various plasma types to generate heat.

The main part of the fusion reactor, the §3"Torus"§r, features four connecting ports for external components. It requires electricity and §bPerfluoromethyl§r cooling to operate.

The §3Klystron§r is the main power source of the fusion reactor, which uses electricity and compressed air, to generate input energy, §eKyU§r, for the connected torus. It will throttle if the buffered electricity or compressed air falls below §e50%§r, and if it falls below the torus' required input level, the plasma will extinguish.

The different plasma types also generate different useful byproducts and differing levels of neutron flux for breeding bulk quantities of materials, such as §6Lithium§r into §6Tritium§r.

Welding the coils will require a §6Blowtorch§r or an §6Acetylene Welding Torch§r.

More information can be found below:

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Fusion_Reactor[/url]

§2For the additional components and power generation methods, please check out the two quests below.§r

§2Multiple fusion reactors will be required soon so it is recommended that Bedrock Ore Processing and Oil Refinement is automated.§r

The §3Plasma Forge§r is a large and advanced assembler that requires a running fusion reactor to work. It can weld plates at twice the speed of a normal welder. It does not accept upgrades, however, it can use up otherwise useless fission fragments and unstable isotopes to gain a temporary §ex4§r speed bonus with no penalty.

§2With 3MTU/t plasma energy input, one can make pre-assembled fusion reactors with a discount.§r§r

§6Weapon steel§r is a steel alloy made by further refining steel in a §3Rotary Furnace§r. As its name implies, it is used in the crafting of weapons and ammunition. It is the next tier of weapons grade alloy after §6Gunmetal§r.
§6Polymer§r is a basic plastic material needed for many recipes. Important uses of it are the §3Centrifuge§r, the §3Catalytic Cracking Tower§r and the §3Electric Arc Furnace§r.

The §6M1TTY Environment Suit§r is a cheap electric armor set that comes with many abilities. It is an excellent armor set for exploring as it comes with very high speed buffs aswell as fast swimming speed.

§6Technetium/Cadmium Steel§r is a steel based alloy mixed with technetium-99/Cadmium which has extreme corrosion resistance. It is frequently used in the late-game and acts as one of the main material gates of the §3Fusion§r and §3Watz§r powerplant.

The §3ZIRNOX§r is the first and cheapest nuclear reactor that one can make. Unlike the §3PWR§r and §3RBMK§r, it is a fully assembled reactor which requires §bWater§r and §bCarbon Dioxide§r to operate.

Due to the low amount of steam the ZIRNOX makes, one can use the singleblock §3Steam Turbines§r, at the cost of §e85%§r efficiency, and a single §3Steam Condenser§r on lower power fuels. Thus, 24 §6Natural Uranium Fuel Rods§r using 14kmB of carbon dioxide will yield a power output of around §e160kHE/s§r.

The §3Chicago Pile§r is a crude early-game breeding reactor meant to produce §6Plutonium§r for use as reactor fuel.

A pile is composed of drilled §6Graphite§r which can hold a variety of items in it, including radioisotope rods (§6Uranium§r, §6Radium§r, §6Plutonium§r), §6Lithium rods§r, and control rods. It does not behave as a unified single block, instead each individual piece of drilled graphite interacts with each other piece in a unique way depending on the rod it contains.

After sufficient flux, the uranium rods in the Chicago Pile will transmute into plutonium rods that can be processed in an anvil into §6Reactor Grade Plutonium§r which can be used in other reactors such as the §3ZIRNOX§r and §3RBMK§r.

The chicago pile requires a significant amount of graphite blocks, which once placed can be drilled into with the hand drill to place any rod into. 

The §6Hand Drill§r can be used to drill holes into the graphite or take core samples of the uranium fuel to determine heat, depletion, and neutron flux. §6Screwdrivers§r are used to extract rods.

The Quest asks for a 3x3 Chicago Pile (without the corners) with a §6Ra226Be§r Rod in the center surrounded by Uranium Rods.

§6Bobmazon§r is an in-game shop where players can spend §6Bottle Caps§r to purchase various items such as building blocks, plants, resourses and many more. To purchase items, one must have unlocked the achievements listed below as "Ratings".

The §6Machine Upgrade Template§r is the baseline for all machine upgrades. Machine upgrades are not only used to increase the efficiency of machines but also to unlock new functions.

§2While in the UI of a machine, hover over an upgrade on NEI to see its effects.§r
The §3Industrial Mixer§r is a machine that is used to mix a fluid with an item and/or another fluid. It can be used instead of a §3Chemical Plant§r for some recipes.

The §3Spent Fuel Pool Drum§r is used to cool down hot nuclear fuel rods for the §3RBMK§r, §3ZIRNOX§r and §3PWR§r. It has 12 slots.

The drum needs to have atleast one of its sides touching §bWater§r to work. The more sides that have water the faster the fuels inside will cool down.
The §3Arc Welder§r is a machine needed for the creation of many components, such as §6Welded Plates§r, §6Missile Parts§r and more. Some Recipes will require a fluid inserted into the welder to work.

The §6Starmetal Pickaxe§r is used as a crafting component for the §6Molten§r and §6Bismuth Pickaxes§r, both being unbreakable and having a lot of abilities. Additionally, both can be used to mine §eDepth Rock§r.

The §3Wood-Burning Generator§r is basic method of producing energy by burning wood. It can run on any burnable items but provides burn time bonuses to logs and wood. It can also run on any flammable fuel by clicking on the arrow below the on/off switch, but it is considerably more inefficient than other fluid burning generators. 

Burning logs in the generator produces §e2kHE/s.§r

The §3Industrial Steam Turbine§r is a multiblock machine that is a much larger and more powerful version of the regular §3Steam Turbine§r. It has an efficiency of §e100%§r and energy output slowly ramps up as §bSteam§r is supplied and slowly goes down as steam cuts out.

The §3Bricked Furnace§r is almost the same as the vanilla furnace, but it can smelt construction materials faster, such as §6Sand§r and §6Cobblestone§r being smelted at double the speed. §6Clay§r and §6Fire Clay§r can be smelted at §e§rquadruple§r the speed, which means that making a full brick block can be done within a vanilla furnace operation. It can also make §6Charcoal§r at double the speed. It can also collect Ashes from burnt fuel.

The §3Iron Furnace§r has the base smelting speed §e20%§r faster than the vanilla furnace, which means it can complete an operation within 8 seconds instead of 10 seconds. Besides being able to smelt faster, it consumes fuel only during operation, so the fuel is never wasted. It also has burn time bonuses for various kinds of fuel, ranging from §e+25%§r for lignite to §e+100%§r for solid fuel.

§dEt Futurum Requiem§r also backports modern furnaces, such as the §3Smoker§r, which cooks food faster, and the §3Blast Furnace§r, which smelts ores faster.
Product of second water washing.
§bVitriol§r is the best way to obtain §bChlorine Gas§r from processing it in an §3Electrolysis Machine§r, with additional byproducts of §bSulfuric Acid§r and §bIron§r.

The §6Versatile Integrated Circuit§r is the first circuit to use §6Bismuth/Arsenic§r. It is used in more advanced machines such as the §3Vacuum Refinery§r and is one of the main components of §6Versatile Circuit Boards§r.
§6Packing Tape§r can be used to break and move drawers without all the items falling out.

The §6Digamma Laser Crystal§r is the fastest and final laser crystal which can be used in a SILEX.

§2If the laser touches any block, the surrounding area will be atomized.

The §6Red Key§r is able to open any container that requires a regular key, regardless of the pin configuration of the lock, and it is one of the only two keys capable of opening the keyhole found on strange stone, in order to open a §eRed Room§r. The key has no durability, and can be reused indefinitely.
The §6Survey Scanner§r is a handheld device that will point out underground resourse deposits, such as §eDepth Rock§r and §eBedrock Ores§r.

The §6Impact Drill§r is an electric pickaxe which has prebuilt enchantments and abilities on it. It is a very useful tool which will make mining way more efficient.

Similar electric tools exist for the axe and shovel.

The §6Trench Mask§r is a basic mask that will protect the user from some dangerous airborne particles while mining. To craft one you must first obtain §6Cloth§r and then piss on it by right clicking while holding it.

§2String can be easily obtained by harvesting Hemp, found in the wild.

The §3Ore Acidizer§r is a useful machine, used for processing various items for utility, ore multiplication, and more. It is powered by electricity and requires various solvents depending on the item. The acidizer is quite the power hungry machine, consuming §e20kHE/s§r.

The §6Geiger counter§r is a device used to measure §eRAD/s§r, in order to inform the player of any eventual radiation. It is an upgrade to the §6Dosimeter§r. It can measure three different types of radiation, those types being chunk radiation, environmental radiation and player contamination.

It can be used in one of two forms, either as a hand-held item or in its block form.

Holding it in the inventory will show a meter on the bottom left of the screen, and right clicking while holding it will send a message in chat showing the various doses of radiation.

It will also click whenever it reads any kind of radiation, a signature function of any dosimeter.

The §6Book of Boxcars§r is an item which allows the crafting of many special items. The book can be found inside §eMeteorite Dungeons§r found randomly in the wilderness, indicated by either skulls on the ground of a black pillar, or in §eRed Rooms§r.
Increase primary or secondary products with §bHydrogen§r or §bChlorine Gas§r.

The §6Powered Drill§r is a modular mining device which can make resourse gathering and excavation much faster than normal pickaxes. 

Various modifications can be attached in the §3Weapon Modification Table§r, such as new drillbits for a larger mining radious or even new engines, which let it run on electricity.
§6Desh Stamps§r have infinite durability, perfect for automation.
The§3 Murky Anvil§r is the ultimate version of the §3Anvil§r, having all recipes unlocked.

§3Transport Drones§r are flying machines which will transport items and fluids between different containers. The drones require no power, and can transport both up and down. §3Waypoints§r can be used to make a better path for the transport drones to move around.

With the §6§3Automatic Buzz Saw§r one can automatically farm trees for their §6Wood§r. If jungle trees are farmed, §6Latex§r automation is also possible.

§3Fans§r, when powered by redstone, can be used to push the dropped items into hoppers or conveyors for storage. Use a §6Drill§r on them to remove the diminishing pushing range.

[F1] for more information.
Product of Second Centrifuging.

The §3Chemical Factory§r is a large version of the §3Chemical Plant§r, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It has double the speed of the chemical plant but consumes twice as much power. Additionally, it consumes §bWater§r as a coolant, and produces §bLow-Pressure Steam§r, so a closed water cycle is recommended.

The §3Assembly Factory§r is a large version of the §3Assembly Machine§r, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It functions the same as the chemical factory.

If you are playing with friends, make sure to invite them in your BetterQuesting Party as to share progression and rewards.

This quest book does not contain all the content from the mod, such as the guns, many armor sets and others. Make sure to browse NEI.

When updating the modpack to newer versions that has introduced changes to the quest book, in case the quests dont update or complete, delete the betterquesting folder in the world file.
After it is deleted, turn on cheats and do "/bq_admin edit true", head over to the chapter of your choice, press the designer button (the one with many squares), click on your quest of choice and finally press the autocomplete button (checkmark) to complete the quests previously completed.

§6Balefire§r is an extremely radioactive substance which can be used to make powerful fuels for the §3RBMK§r, aswell as §bBF Rocket Fuel§r for power production. High radiation resistant equipment is needed to hold the item. §6Thermonuclear Ashes§r can be produced sustainably as a byproduct from §bAntimatter - BF Rocket Fuel§r.

The High-Tech Bomb Defusing Device can extract balefire shards from duds.
The §3Drainage Pipe§r allows the dumping of fluids and gasses into the environment at the cost of pollution.
Product of second water washing.

§6Latex§r is an early game rubber which can be used instead of normal §6Rubber§r, such as cheaper conveyors. Before the §3Press§r is unlocked, it can be made using dandelions in a crafting table.

§2If a jungle biome is too far away, beach biomes provide jungle wood and saplings from palm trees.§r

The §3Big-Ass Tank§r is the largest fluid storage container, capable of storing 16000000mB of fluids, aswell as being able to hold strongly corrosive fluids.

§2Must be placed on solid ground or else it will tilt.§r

The §3Firebox§r and the §3Heating Oven§r are machines capable of producing heat (§eTU§r) from solid fuels for any machines that require heat to operate.

Both machines are similar in operation. In order for them to transfer heat, another machine for receiving the heat must be placed on top, such that the copper heat plate on the receiving machine sits on top of the copper heat plate of the heat producing machine.

Once constructed, these machines can be filled with solid fuel, which will burn until either the fuel runs out, or the heat buffer is filled. No fuel will be consumed if its buffer is full — as such, both machines are fairly efficient at conserving fuel.

The primary difference in these two machines lie in their speed: the firebox burns fuel much slower at full efficiency, whilst the heating oven produces five time the heat (but eight times faster). Despite its inefficiency, the heating oven is often preferred for its much higher heat outputs and heat capacity. However, it cannot heat a stirling engine, as its base output (500 TU/t) will automatically over-speed the engine; the heavy stirling engine does not have this issue.

Additionally, the heating oven can receive heat from other heat producing machines placed underneath it: multiple can be stacked for heat-hungry machines like the crucible. The heat received, however, is halved when transferring to the machine above.

All ores must be processed in a §3Centrifuge§r in order to extract products from them. The first stage of centrifuging will produce a second stage of ore which can either be centrifuged again to immediately get primary products and finish processing, or can be washed with solvents to acquire useful byproducts.

Gravel obtained from centrifuging can be processed into concrete for base building, in a §3SILEX§r for additional byproducts, such as §6Lithium§r and §6Boron§r, or shredded into sand for §6Silicon§r.
§3Pipe Anchors§r are non solid fluid ducts which can be used instead of normal ducts.

Most ore processing stages can be passed through a §3Combination Oven§r or a §3Pyrolysis Oven§r to produce §bVitriol§r. The ore itself will not be affected by this process - yielding the same outputs whether or not the ore is roasted - so this can be done to add bonus byproducts (from processing the vitriol) effectively for free.

§bReformate§r is a product of §bCrude Oil§r obtained via a §3Vacuum Refinery§r or from processing §bNaptha§r in a §3Hydrotreater§r.

§2This step can be skipped if making Jet Fuel and BTX using a Hydrotreater.

The §3Stirling Engine§r uses heat from a §3Heating Oven§r or a §3§r§3Firebox§r to produce power. If a Heating Oven is used to heat a Stirling engine, it will likely over-speed and damage it, sending the main gear flying. The heavy Stirling engine does not have this issue. 

A firebox running on coal with a stirling engine produces §e2kHE/s§r, while a heating oven with a heavy stirling engine produces §e10kHE/s§r.

§bOre Slop§r§r can be processed most efficiently in an §3Electrolysis Machine§r, giving §6Mercury§r, §6Niter§r, §6Sulfur§r and §6Limestone§r. Products obtained from the processing can be used to make acids for the rest of the bedrock ore plant.

The §3RBMK§r is a modular boiling-water type nuclear fission reactor which consists entirely of concrete columns. Each of these columns is either blank or has a specific function that it performs such as holding fuel rods, moderating neutrons, or storing §bWater§r to be boiled into §bSteam§r. Each column will also exchange heat with the column next to it such that temperature differences between columns will gradually equalize within the reactor. If any column reaches §e1500°C§r, the reactor will explode incredibly violently, spraying scrap and immensely radioactive material in every direction.

Due to the complex and expansive nature of the RBMK, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.

For recipes which arent made in a crafting table, such as the §6Wires§r and the §6Analog Circuit§r itself, the pattern terminal needs to be switched to the processing mode, which has a furnace icon.



After all the patterns have been created, insert them into their respective interfaces.
Make sure to enable blocking mode on the interfaces as not to have multiple different recipes enter the interface at once.



Finally, after everything has been set up, the option to order items will be shown in the ME terminal.

The §6ME Glass Cable - Fluix§r is a cable used to transmit data and energy between devices in an ME Network. It is capable of transmitting §f§e8 channels§r simultaneously.

The §6Quartz Fiber§r is used to transfer energy, but not channels.

§6Cable Anchors§r can be used to seperate ME cable connections. They can also be used to make §6Facades§r for the cables.
The §3Cell Workbench§r allow to filter cells to accept specific items. It can prove useful for when making a subnet for §eBedrock Ore Processing§r.

§6Certus Quartz§r is an important material in AE2. It is dropped when mining or processing certus quartz ore at the rate of one to four, the yield is affected by a tool's Fortune enchantment. Certus Quartz is often interchangeable with vanilla §6Nether Quartz§r in the recipes for basic tools, such as the §6Quartz Cutting Knife§r. Certus quartz ore can be acidized or centrifuged for an increased yield.

§2Certus quartz can later be made in a Chemical Plant using nether quartz.
The §3Charger§r is a machine which will charge §6Certus Quartz Crystals§r into their charged form at the expense of power.

The Crafting CPU is a multiblock structure composed of §3Crafting Co-Processing Units§r and §3Crafting Storage§r. When placed next to eachother they form one CPU which is used when placing orders via §3Interfaces§r. The more crafting co-processing units the more tasks the CPU can do in parallel while more crafting storage allows for bigger orders to be made.

The §3Crystal Growth Accelerator§r is a machine that uses energy to accelerate the process of crystal purification. This process transforms crystal seeds into pure versions of their fully developed counterparts.

The §6Dense ME Fluix Cables§r can be used to transmit §e32 channels§r from an §3ME Controller§r.

One controller is capable of connecting up to 6 dense cables, in turn each can branch off to 4 smaller cable lines connecting up to 192 ME devices to the network.

The §6Smart Dense Cable§r also displays the amount of channels that are been used, but is known to be less performance friendly than the dense covered cables.

In addition there are 16 colored cables made with the appropriate dye. The colored cables allow contact with other cables without sharing the signal or connecting to any other cable but the ones of the same colour.
The §3Energy Acceptor§r transfers energy into the ME system. In combination with an §3HE to RF Converter§r, the ME system can be powered.

The §3Energy Cell§r acts as a battery for the ME network. It becomes useful when the ME system begins to consume large amounts of energy, so a buffer is needed so it doesnt turn on and off constantly.

§6Fluix Crystals§r are another crystal type which is used in crafting recipes throughout the mod. The crystal comes in two forms, the regular fluix crystal and the §6Pure Fluix Crystal§r.

To create a fluix crystal, 1§6 Charged Certus Quartz§r, 1 §6Nether Quartz§r, and 1 §6Redstone Dust§r must be dropped into a pool of §bWater§r. They will be consumed and output 2 fluix crystals.

§2Fluix crystals can later be made in a Chemical Plant using charged certus quartz and redstone.

The §3ME Export Bus§r is an ME component which is used to export items from the ME network into a machine or other input inventory. 

The §3ME Import Bus§r is an ME component which is used to import items directly into the ME Network from a machine or other output inventory.

§2It is recommended that Interfaces are used over Export/Import buses for performance reasons.

The §3ME Controller§r acts as the routing hub of an ME network. It has the ability to transmit data throughout the ME Network using §e32 channels§r per side. The §6ME Dense Cable§r is the only cable that can support 32 channel simultaneously so it can be used as a main data line to connect to another ME Controller or branch off into 8 channel distribution lines via §6ME Glass Cable§r, §6ME Covered Cable§r (less lag)§r or §6ME Smart Cable§r (displays the amount of channels used) to connect all the devices and multi-block structures in the network.
The §3ME Drive§r serves as the storage of the ME system, in which §6Storage Cells§r can be put and store items.

The §3ME Interface§r is a block which allows the ME Network to interact with machines and inventories. On their own, they can be used to automatically stock inventories, but can be used with §6ME Patterns§r later on for autocrafting.
The §3ME IO Port§r can transfer the contents of storage cells into an ME Network and back.
§6ME Patterns§r are used to encode recipes to be used in §3Interfaces§r. They can be encoded in a §3Pattern Terminal§r.

The §3ME Storage Bus§r, when attached to an block/tile entity with an inventory (generally a storage unit, such as chests or a §3Drawer Controller§r), will include that inventory's contents in the ME System.

§eSubnetworks§r are ME networks which can be accessed from a §eMain Network§r. In §dNTM§r§r they can be useful for storing items from passive processes without flooding the main storage network.

§2This quest serves as a guide on how to set up a subnet, which can be used to store the resourses that Bedrock Ore Processing produces.§r

In the image below are two ME networks, the §cRed§r one as the §cMainnet§r, and the §9Blue§r one as the §9Subnet§r.



For the purposes of this quest, the main network will store dirt blocks, while the subnet will store copper blocks.





To make the contents of the subnet, the copper blocks, visible to the main net, one must make an §3Interface§r-§3Storage Bus§r§r combo. The storage bus must be on the side of the main network.



Make sure to filter the main network storage bus, and to also make it "Extract Only".



Now the main network has access to materials stored on the sub network, which can be used for crafting.
The §3ME Terminal§r is used to access all available items in the ME Network, including craftable ones.
§6Modifier Cards§r allow for modification to various ME components, such as speeding them up or being able to toggle them on and off using redstone.
The §3Molecular Assembler§r is used to autocraft anything that can be made in a crafting table.

The §6Network Tool§r, when right-clicking on any network device will bring up the tool's interface showing all devices connected to the network as well as network details. As any wrench, shift clicking on a cable will remove it.

§6P2P§r Tunnel or "Point to Point Tunnels" are a versatile configurable system to move items / redstone / power / and fluids from one location to another though an existing ME Network without storage.

Tunnels are §e1 input to N outputs§r. This means you can output to as many points as you want, but only input at a single point per tunnel.

Networks can support any number of tunnels, of any different types, and they all function independently.

ME tunnels can be used to carry channels from one location to another, and can carry up to §e32 channels§r, same as a §6ME Dense Cable§r, while only requiring a single channel per point, making tunnels a very powerful tool to expand me networks, especially over a distance. However with the great flex-ability they give you comes a limitation, the channel of a p2p tunnel cannot be carried by another p2p tunnel, meaning that you cannot nest them recursively.

To configure a P2P tunnel you must first attune the tunnel to carry what you want it to, then you need to configure the outputs to their input. You configure the connections by using the §6Memory Card§r. First Shift+Right Click the input to save it on your memory card, then simply right click the different outputs to store the input onto the outputs. this also sets the type of the output to match the type of the input.

§2An advanced version of the Memory Card can also be made, which interacts with the entire network.

§3P2P ME§r can be used to transport massive amounts of channels without laying many cables.

§2This quest serves as a guide on how to effectively use P2P ME.§r

Once an §3Energy Acceptor§r has been set up, it is highly recommended (and likely needed) that an §3Energy Cell§r is placed next to it as to ensure that there is enough power going to the system, as more components increase the energy demands of the ME system.

After that, 2 §3ME Controllers§r are required, one to provide the channels that machines will use, and another to transport the other's channels by the P2P connections. The top controller can be made bigger by attaching more controllers next to it.



After the controllers are placed, on the top controller, a P2P Tunnel - ME needs to be placed on any side. The §9Blue Cable§r will serve as the cable that connects the P2P connections, and as such, it needs to be connected to the bottom controller.



By linking the P2P connections together using a §6Memory Card§r, the 32 channels from one side of the top controller will only use 1 channel from the bottom controller to be transported to any destination. The §cRed Cable§r now has access to 32 channels.





By expanding on the previous example, more connections can be added to fully utilize all channels.
The §6Pattern Capacity Card§r can be used to add 9 more slots for patterns in an §3ME Interface§r. Up to 3 cards can be inserted.

A §3Quantum Network Bridge§r is a multiblock structure that connects 2 potentially distant, or even in different dimensions, network fragments together. Created by crafting 8 §3ME Quantum Ring§r and a §3ME Quantum Link Chamber§r and placing the ME quantum link chamber in the center, and sourrounding it in the 8 ME quantum rings.



Each quantum network bridge requires power to function. This power must be provided from the network fragment it is attached to until the bridge is linked; at which time power from either side will be available. However if power is lost, connectivity will fail and power will be drained from the side the bridge is on in attempt to restore connection.

To establish a link between 2 quantum network bridges, you must create a pair of §6Quantum Entangled Singularities§r. One of each will be placed inside of a particular connection. Each Bridge may only connect to one other bridge.



AE2 Singularities are created by dumping 256k of any block inside a §3Matter Condenser§r. Singularities can become quantum entangled by dropping a singularity and ender dust and then exploding them together.

§3Spatial IO§r is a way to cut-and-paste physical volumes of space in your world. It works by swapping the defined volume with an identically-sized volume in the spatial storage dimension, sending whatever's in the pylon array to the spatial storage dimension, and whatever's in the dimension to the pylon array.

Spatial IO requires a specific arrangement of its components in order to function, and define the volume to be cut-and-pasted. All of the components must be on the same network in order to function, and you can have only one spatial IO setup on a network. Thus, a subnetwork is recommended.

The §3Spatial IO Port§r controls the spatial IO operation. It shows stats on the multiblock setup, and holds the spatial cells

To perform a spatial IO operation, place a §6Spatial Storage Cell§r in the input slot and give the spatial IO port a redstone pulse. It will then swap the volume in the pylons with the volume in the spatial storage dimension. This means that if you send some set of blocks to the spatial storage dimension, then put another set of blocks in the pylons, put the cell back in the input slot, and trigger the IO port again, the 2nd set of blocks will disappear and the 1st set of blcks will reappear.

Any entity in the defined volume, including you, will be carried along, and if you have no way of getting out, you will be trapped in the spatial storage dimension.

§3Spatial Pylons§r are the main part of a spatial IO setup, and define the volume to be affected. The volume is defined by the bounding box of the outside of the pylons, contracted in by 1 block in all directions.
The §6ME Storage Housing§r is the outer shell of a §6Storage Cell§r. There are many tiers of storage cells, all of which require the use of NTM machines to be crafted.

The §3Security Terminal§r can be used to specify what players are allowed to interact with in the ME network which can be useful in multiplayer. It can also be used to link a §6Wireless Terminal§r to the ME network. Atleast one §3Wireless Access Point§r is required, and its range can be expanded using §6Wireless Boosters§r.
